title: Jellyfish UAP debunked
summary: unidentified clip speaker tells of Jellyfish UAP debunked, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it ended up being debunked it it wasn't any it was not a a u UAP

related.note: The same jellyfish UAP video Corbell released, but this speaker claims it was debunked and was not a UAP, which conflicts with the story's account of it as a UFO.

plain: On an episode of a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, an unnamed speaker, presented as a witness drawing on official information, talks about a video of a so-called jellyfish object, a floating shape said to look like a jellyfish. The speaker says it ended up being debunked and was not a UAP, the official term for an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, the newer name for a UFO. If true, it means at least one famous strange sighting has an ordinary explanation.
